project: 美国SEC批准24X交易所开展代币化证券交易试点
project_en: SEC Approves 24X Exchange Tokenized Securities Pilot
regulator: US-FED
summary: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）批准24X国家交易所提交的规则修改，允许其在存管信托公司（DTC）运营的试点计划期间交易代币化证券。该规则修改即日生效。
summary_en: The U.S. SEC approved rule changes by 24X National Exchange to permit tokenized securities trading during a pilot program operated by the Depository Trust Company (DTC). The amendment takes effect immediately.
sourceName: US Federal Register 联邦公报

project: 新电途充电桩收益权 RWA（全国首单新能源 RWA）
project_en: Xindiantu charging-pile revenue rights RWA (first new-energy RWA from the Chinese mainland)
asset: 新能源充电桩收益权
regulator: 香港金管局 Ensemble 沙盒（四大代币化案例之一）
partners: 蚂蚁数科（蚂蚁链）· 瑞银
summary: 朗新旗下新电途平台的部分充电桩作为锚定资产，基于可信数据在蚂蚁链上发行数字资产，每个代币代表对应充电桩的部分收益权，融资用于储能和充电桩产业。
summary_en: Charging piles operated on LongShine's Xindiantu platform were tokenized on Ant Chain; each token represents a share of the corresponding pile's revenue. Proceeds fund energy storage and charging infrastructure.

project: 鑫阳光户用光伏 RWA（全国首单光伏 RWA）
project_en: Xinyangguang residential solar RWA (first photovoltaic RWA from the Chinese mainland)
asset: 湖北/湖南 82MW 户用光伏电站（约 3000 座）
partners: 蚂蚁数科
summary: 协鑫能科将两湖地区约 82MW「鑫阳光」户用分布式光伏电站的价值、运营、收益数据打包上链发行数字通证，获得多家知名投资机构支持，为国内规模最大的一单 RWA 融资。
summary_en: GCL-ET tokenized ~82MW of residential rooftop solar assets (about 3,000 stations in Hubei and Hunan), packaging value, operation and revenue data on-chain. It was the largest RWA financing from the Chinese mainland at the time.
sourceName: 巨潮资讯网（法定披露平台）

project: 换电实体资产 RWA（全球首单换电 RWA）
project_en: Battery-swap real asset RWA (world's first battery-swap RWA)
asset: 全国换电柜与锂电池运营收益权
regulator: 香港发行（胜利证券 8540.HK 担任基金管理人）
partners: 蚂蚁数科 · Conflux · VDX · AW3 家办
summary: 巡鹰集团旗下换电柜与锂电池作为锚定资产，通过发行由香港胜利证券担任管理人的 RWA 基金产品完成，为全球首单换电实体资产 RWA。
summary_en: Xunying tokenized its battery-swap cabinets and lithium batteries via an RWA fund managed by Hong Kong-listed Victory Securities (8540.HK) — the world's first battery-swap real-asset RWA.

company: 左岸芯慧（上海）数据技术
project: 「马陆葡萄」农业品牌 RWA（全国首个农业品牌 RWA）
project_en: "Malu Grape" agricultural brand RWA (first agricultural brand RWA in China)
asset: 农业品牌资产及数据资产
summary: 利用区块链技术实现马陆葡萄品牌资产和相应数据资产的代币化，完成 1000 万元融资。
summary_en: Tokenized the Malu Grape brand and its associated data assets via blockchain, raising RMB 10 million.

company: 国富量子（MaiCapital × 星路科技）
project: Sunvest CFPT LPF · 加拿大油气田通证化基金（亚洲首单油气 LPF）
project_en: Sunvest CFPT LPF · Canadian oil & gas tokenized fund (first in Asia)
asset: 加拿大成熟油气区块采矿权益（第一顺位抵押 + 采油现金流）
regulator: 香港有限合伙基金（LPF），通过香港证监会（SFC）审查备案
partners: 曜金资本（GP）· MaiCapital（9号牌管理人）· 星路 Finloop（通证化）· 君合（法律）
summary: 国富量子（00290.HK）控股 MaiCapital 与星路科技联合推进，以香港有限合伙基金（LPF）为发行载体，将加拿大成熟油气田净现金流映射为链上通证（每枚通证对应 1 个合伙权益单位，以太坊 + Solana），通过 SFC 审查，仅面向专业投资者。
summary_en: Led by MaiCapital (controlled by Guofu Quantum, 00290.HK) with Finloop as tokenization provider, this Hong Kong Limited Partnership Fund tokenizes net cash flows from producing Canadian oil & gas blocks — one token per partnership unit, on Ethereum and Solana. Cleared SFC review; professional investors only.

project: 全球纽带代币化收入有限合伙基金（香港首支 SFC 备案代币化 LPF）
project_en: Global Nexus Tokenised Income LPF (first SFC-filed tokenized LPF in Hong Kong)
asset: 全球债券组合（传统金融资产）
regulator: 香港证监会（SFC）备案的有限合伙基金（LPF）
partners: 金杜律师事务所（法律）· NVT（技术）
summary: 金洲资管（SFC 9 号牌）在香港设立的首支 RWA 通证化有限合伙基金，采用「传统份额登记册 + 以太坊 ERC-20 链上登记册」双登记结构，基金份额以 ERC-20 代币形式彻底通证化，支持 OTC 二级转让。
summary_en: GCAM (SFC Type 9 licensed) set up Hong Kong's first SFC-filed tokenized LPF, using a dual-register structure: a traditional share register plus an on-chain ERC-20 register on Ethereum. Fund interests are fully tokenized with OTC secondary transfer support.

company: 星路金融 × 安本投资（Aberdeen）
project: abrdn 全球私募市场基金代币化份额分销（SFC 持牌发行）
project_en: Tokenized distribution of abrdn Global Private Markets Fund (issued under SFC licence)
asset: abrdn I ICAV 全球私募市场基金单位（PE / 私募信贷 / 基建 / 地产 / 自然资源）
regulator: 星路金融持香港证监会（SFC）牌照发行，仅限专业投资者
partners: 星路金融（Finloop Finance）· 安本投资（Aberdeen）
summary: 星路金融获安本投资委任，在香港以自身 SFC 牌照发行与 abrdn I ICAV 全球私募市场基金单位经济特征直接挂钩的代币化代表物，星路作为代理人持有底层基金单位，仅限专业投资者认购。
summary_en: Finloop Finance, appointed by Aberdeen Investments, issues tokens in Hong Kong under its own SFC licence whose economics are directly linked to units of the abrdn I ICAV Global Private Markets Fund held by Finloop as agent. Professional investors only.

project: HOTAI 数字证券平台（hotai.uk，自称 STO/MSB 合规）
project_en: HOTAI digital securities platform (hotai.uk, self-claimed STO/MSB compliance)
asset: 自称数字证券基础设施（无公开已发行产品实证）
regulator: 仅 SEC Form D 自我申报（Rule 506(c)）+ FinCEN MSB 登记——均为申报性质，非审批
partners: Vertalo（第三方过户代理服务，非自身持牌）
summary: 网站宣称「SEC 备案 + MSB 合规」。经 SEC EDGAR 核实：CIK 0002135153 确为 Hotai Securities Inc（特拉华注册代理地址），2026-05-14 提交一份 Form D 私募豁免申报。注意：Form D 与 MSB 均为自我申报/登记，SEC 与 FinCEN 不作审核背书；禁止美国及中国内地用户参与却主打「美国合规」，任何官方登记册均未收录，合规状态存疑。
summary_en: The site claims "SEC filing + MSB compliance". EDGAR confirms CIK 0002135153 is Hotai Securities Inc (Delaware registered-agent address) with a single Form D notice filed 2026-05-14. Note: Form D and MSB registration are self-declarations — neither SEC nor FinCEN approves or endorses them. Barring U.S. and mainland China users while touting "U.S. compliance" is a red flag; not found in any official registry.

project: Shift Series 杠杆/反向代币化股票（Solana，6 种）
project_en: Shift Series leveraged/inverse tokenized equities (Solana, 6 tokens)
asset: TSLA 2x多/1x空、SOX 半导体 3x多/空、SPX 3x多/空
regulator: 代币未注册为证券（not registered securities），美国/英国用户受限
partners: Alpaca Markets（托管）· Chainlink · SNZ Holding
summary: 2026-05-26 在 Solana 上线 6 个杠杆/反向代币化股票产品，自称「首个无清算杠杆 RWA 协议」，链下 Alpaca 托管、日度再平衡。注意：代币未注册为证券、无公开牌照或备案编号；平台币 $SHFT 持有人不足 50、市值约 13 万美元，配合空投拉新活动——属早期无许可 DeFi 协议，「合法」仅为项目方自述，未经任何监管机构证实。
summary_en: Launched six leveraged/inverse tokenized equity products on Solana on 2026-05-26, self-described as the first liquidation-free leveraged RWA protocol, with off-chain Alpaca custody and daily rebalancing. Note: the tokens are not registered securities and no licence or filing number is public; the $SHFT platform token has under 50 holders and ~$130K market cap with airdrop-driven growth — an early-stage permissionless DeFi protocol whose "legality" is self-claimed and unverified by any regulator.
sourceName: 项目官网（无官方登记册记录）

project: BUIDL（USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund）
project_en: BUIDL (USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund)
asset: 代币化货币市场基金（现金/美债/回购）
amount: 初始 1 亿美元，峰值超 20 亿美元
regulator: 美国 SEC（Reg D 豁免发行）
partners: Securitize · BNY Mellon
summary: 贝莱德在以太坊发行首只代币化基金 BUIDL，通过 Securitize Markets 认购，投资现金、美债与回购，每日计息按月以新代币分红。后扩展至多条公链，为规模最大的代币化美债产品。
summary_en: BlackRock launched its first tokenized fund BUIDL on Ethereum, subscribed via Securitize Markets, investing in cash, T-bills and repos with daily accrual paid monthly as new tokens. It later expanded to multiple chains with AUM peaking above $2B.
sourceName: 美国 SEC EDGAR 备案

company: Franklin Templeton 富兰克林邓普顿
project: FOBXX / BENJI（Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund）
project_en: FOBXX / BENJI (Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund)
asset: 代币化货币市场基金（美国政府证券）
regulator: 美国 SEC 注册公募基金（1940 年投资公司法）
partners: Stellar · Polygon · BNY Mellon
summary: 全球首只使用公有链记录基金份额的美国注册货币市场基金，投资者通过 Benji Investments 平台持有 BENJI 代币，后扩展至多条公链。
summary_en: The first U.S.-registered mutual fund to use a public blockchain to record share ownership. Investors hold BENJI tokens via the Benji platform; the fund later expanded to multiple chains.

project: OUSG（代币化美债基金）
project_en: OUSG (tokenized U.S. Treasuries fund)
asset: 短期美债 ETF（底层 BlackRock iShares）
regulator: 美国 SEC Reg D
partners: BlackRock iShares · Coinbase Custody
summary: 面向合格投资者的代币化短期美债基金，底层为 BlackRock 短期美债 ETF，支持 24/7 铸造赎回，是最早跑通的代币化美债产品之一。
summary_en: A tokenized short-term U.S. Treasuries fund for qualified purchasers, underpinned by a BlackRock iShares T-bill ETF, offering 24/7 mint/redeem — among the first tokenized Treasury products.

project: USDY（美元收益代币）
project_en: USDY (yield-bearing dollar token)
asset: 短期美债 + 银行活期存款
regulator: 离岸结构发行（面向非美国投资者）
summary: 由短期美债和银行存款支持的收益型美元代币，面向非美国零售与机构投资者，持有者自动获得美债收益，已部署至多条公链。
summary_en: A yield-bearing dollar token backed by short-term Treasuries and bank deposits, open to non-U.S. retail and institutions; holders accrue Treasury yield automatically. Deployed across multiple chains.

project: USTB（代币化短债基金）
project_en: USTB (tokenized short-duration T-bill fund)
asset: 短期美国国债
regulator: 美国 SEC 注册（链上过户代理记录份额）
partners: 以太坊 · Plume
summary: 由 Compound 创始人 Robert Leshner 创立，美国 SEC 注册的短债基金，使用代币作为链上份额过户记录，支持 USDC 即时申购赎回。
summary_en: Founded by Compound creator Robert Leshner, USTB is an SEC-registered short-duration Treasury fund whose token serves as the on-chain transfer-agent record, with instant USDC subscriptions.

company: Hashnote（2025 年被 Circle 收购）
project: USYC（代币化美债收益币）
project_en: USYC (tokenized Treasury yield coin)
asset: 美国国债逆回购组合
amount: 规模峰值超 15 亿美元
summary: 由美国国债逆回购支持的收益代币，曾长期位居代币化美债规模榜首；2025 年 1 月 Hashnote 被 Circle 收购，USYC 与 USDC 生态打通。
summary_en: A yield token backed by Treasury reverse repos and long the largest tokenized Treasury product by AUM. Circle acquired Hashnote in January 2025, integrating USYC with the USDC ecosystem.

project: TBILL Vault（代币化美债金库）
project_en: TBILL Vault (tokenized T-bill vault)
asset: 短期美国国债
regulator: 获穆迪投资级评级的代币化基金
summary: 亚洲团队运营的代币化美债平台，TBILL 是首个获得穆迪「A」评级的代币化美债产品，面向合格投资者 24/7 铸造赎回。
summary_en: A Singapore-based tokenized T-bill platform; TBILL was the first tokenized Treasury product to receive a Moody's investment-grade rating, offering 24/7 mint/redeem to accredited investors.

project: STBT（短期美债代币）
project_en: STBT (short-term Treasury bill token)
asset: 短期美债 + 货币市场工具
summary: 1:1 锚定短期美债与货币市场工具，T+0 铸造赎回，是亚洲最早跑通的代币化美债产品之一，后续扩展至黄金代币 XAUm。
summary_en: STBT is pegged 1:1 to short-term Treasuries and money-market instruments with T+0 mint/redeem — one of Asia's first tokenized Treasury products. Matrixdock later launched gold token XAUm.

project: WisdomTree Prime 数字基金系列（含 WTGXX 货币市场基金）
project_en: WisdomTree Prime digital funds (incl. WTGXX money market fund)
asset: 货币市场 / 美债 / 股票指数等 10+ 只数字基金
regulator: 美国 SEC 注册
summary: 老牌 ETF 发行商推出的区块链原生基金系列，通过 WisdomTree Prime App 面向美国零售用户，份额以代币形式记录在 Stellar 与以太坊。
summary_en: A suite of blockchain-native funds from the veteran ETF issuer, offered to U.S. retail via the WisdomTree Prime app, with shares recorded as tokens on Stellar and Ethereum.

project: bIB01（代币化 iShares 短债 ETF）
project_en: bIB01 (tokenized iShares short T-bill ETF)
asset: iShares 0-1 年美债 ETF
regulator: 瑞士 DLT 法案发行框架
summary: 瑞士发行的 ERC-20 代币，1:1 追踪 iShares 0-1 年美债 ETF，白名单地址间可自由转让，被大量 DeFi 协议用作抵押品，是 xStocks 的前身产品线。
summary_en: A Swiss-issued ERC-20 token tracking the iShares 0-1yr T-bill ETF 1:1, freely transferable between whitelisted wallets and widely used as DeFi collateral — the precursor to xStocks.

project: HCSG II 医疗战略成长基金代币化份额
project_en: Tokenized exposure to Health Care Strategic Growth Fund II (HCSG II)
asset: 私募股权基金（医疗成长股权）
amount: 母基金规模 40 亿美元
regulator: 美国 SEC Reg D 506(c)
partners: Securitize · Avalanche
summary: Securitize 将 KKR 旗下医疗成长基金的部分权益在 Avalanche 公链代币化，是大型私募股权基金首次上公链，投资门槛从千万美元级降至 10 万美元。
summary_en: Securitize tokenized an interest in KKR's $4B Health Care Strategic Growth Fund II on Avalanche — the first tokenization of a major PE fund on a public chain, cutting minimums to $100K.

project: 三只旗舰基金代币化 feeder（直投 / 私募信贷 / 二级市场）
project_en: Three tokenized flagship feeder funds (direct equity / private credit / secondaries)
asset: 私募股权母基金
amount: 门槛降至 1 万美元级
regulator: 美国 SEC Reg D
partners: Securitize · ADDX · Polygon
summary: 管理近万亿美元的私募巨头将三只旗舰基金通过 Securitize 等三个平台代币化，合格个人投资者最低 1 万美元即可参与。
summary_en: The private-markets giant tokenized three flagship funds via Securitize, ADDX and Infinite Whisk, opening access to qualified individuals from ~$10K minimums.

project: ACRED（Apollo Diversified Credit Securitize Fund）
project_en: ACRED (Apollo Diversified Credit Securitize Fund)
asset: 多元化私募信贷（直贷 / 资产支持 / 结构性信贷）
regulator: 美国 SEC Reg D
partners: Securitize · Wormhole（首发六条公链）
summary: 全球最大另类资管之一 Apollo 的私募信贷基金代币化 feeder，首发 Aptos、Avalanche、Ethereum、Ink、Polygon、Solana 六链，Coinbase 资管与 Kraken 参投。
summary_en: Apollo's tokenized feeder into its Diversified Credit Fund, launched with Securitize across six chains (Aptos, Avalanche, Ethereum, Ink, Polygon, Solana) with investment from Coinbase AM and Kraken.

project: Maple 链上信贷市场（蓝筹池 / Syrup / 美债池）
project_en: Maple on-chain credit markets (Blue Chip / Syrup / Treasury pools)
asset: 机构信用贷 + 美债收益
amount: 累计放款超 50 亿美元
summary: 最早的机构级链上信贷市场之一，向加密机构提供抵押贷款，经历 2022 年坏账出清后转型，现以 Syrup 收益产品为主，TVL 重回高位。
summary_en: One of the first institutional on-chain credit markets, lending to crypto firms. After a 2022 credit reset it pivoted to the Syrup yield product line, returning to multi-billion TVL.

project: Centrifuge 信贷池（New Silver / BlockTower Credit 等）
project_en: Centrifuge credit pools (New Silver / BlockTower Credit etc.)
asset: 房地产过桥贷 / 结构化信贷 / 美债
amount: BlockTower 系列金库超 2.2 亿美元
partners: MakerDAO · Aave · Coinbase
summary: RWA 上链先驱协议：2021 年帮助 New Silver 通过 MakerDAO 完成首笔 RWA 金库融资，2022 年 BlockTower 在 Centrifuge 设立超 2 亿美元结构化信贷金库。
summary_en: An RWA pioneer: in 2021 New Silver drew the first real-world vault financing from MakerDAO via Centrifuge; in 2022 BlockTower launched $200M+ structured credit vaults on the protocol.

project: Goldfinch 新兴市场信贷协议
project_en: Goldfinch emerging-market credit protocol
asset: 新兴市场金融科技公司信用贷
amount: 累计贷款超 1 亿美元
summary: 无需加密抵押的去中心化信贷协议，向非洲、东南亚、拉美的金融科技放贷机构提供链上美元资金，获 a16z、Coinbase Ventures 投资。
summary_en: A decentralized credit protocol requiring no crypto collateral, channeling on-chain dollars to fintech lenders across Africa, Southeast Asia and Latin America. Backed by a16z and Coinbase Ventures.

project: Credix 拉美私募信贷市场
project_en: Credix Latin America private credit marketplace
asset: 拉美金融科技放款方应收账融资
summary: 连接机构资金与拉美（以巴西为主）金融科技放款方的私募信贷协议，融资方以应收账款与消费信贷组合获得链上美元资金。
summary_en: A private credit marketplace connecting institutional capital with Latin American (mainly Brazilian) fintech lenders, financing receivables and consumer credit portfolios with on-chain dollars.

project: Figure 房屋净值贷款（HELOC）全线链上化
project_en: Figure HELOC lending fully on Provenance blockchain
asset: 房屋净值贷款 / 消费信贷
amount: 累计链上放款超百亿美元
partners: Provenance Blockchain
summary: 美国金融科技公司 Figure 把房屋净值贷款的发放、登记、交易全流程放在 Provenance 区块链上，是链上信贷规模最大的传统金融实践。
summary_en: Figure originates, registers and trades home-equity loans entirely on the Provenance blockchain — the largest traditional-finance credit operation on-chain, with $10B+ originated.

project: xStocks 代币化美股（首发 60+ 种）
project_en: xStocks tokenized U.S. equities (60+ at launch)
asset: 美股与 ETF（苹果/特斯拉/英伟达等）
regulator: 瑞士 DLT 法案发行框架
partners: Kraken · Bybit · Solana（主链）
summary: Backed 在瑞士发行、Kraken 与 Bybit 首发的 1:1 股票背书代币，覆盖 60+ 美股与 ETF，主要在 Solana 发行；2025 年 12 月 Backed 被 Kraken 收购。
summary_en: Backed-issued, Kraken/Bybit-listed tokens backed 1:1 by real shares, covering 60+ U.S. stocks and ETFs mainly on Solana. Kraken acquired Backed in December 2025.

project: Ondo Global Markets（代币化美股平台，201 种资产）
project_en: Ondo Global Markets (tokenized equities platform, 201 assets)
asset: 美股与 ETF（100+ 上线即覆盖，后扩至 201 种）
amount: 上线数月规模超 4.6 亿美元
regulator: 获列支敦士登批准，分销覆盖 30 个 EEA 国家
summary: 上线即成全球最大代币化股票平台（市占过半）；美国 SEC 于 2025 年 11 月结束对 Ondo 的调查且未起诉，为代币化股票合规化标志性事件。
summary_en: Launched as the largest tokenized equities platform with over half the market. The SEC closed its probe of Ondo in November 2025 without charges — a landmark for compliant tokenized stocks.

project: dShares（88 种代币化美股）
project_en: dShares (88 tokenized U.S. stocks)
asset: 美股（1:1 背书真实股票）
regulator: 美国 SEC 注册过户代理（Transfer Agent）
partners: Arbitrum · Coinbase WaaS
summary: 首个获美国 SEC 注册过户代理资质的代币化股票发行方，dShares 1:1 由真实股票背书，持有人享股息，向企业客户输出「股票代币即服务」。
summary_en: The first tokenized-stock issuer registered as an SEC transfer agent. dShares are backed 1:1 by real shares, pass through dividends, and are offered as tokenization-as-a-service.

project: Robinhood EU 股票代币（200+ 种，Arbitrum）
project_en: Robinhood EU stock tokens (200+, on Arbitrum)
asset: 美股与 ETF（另含 OpenAI/SpaceX 私募份额代币）
partners: Arbitrum（并宣布将自建 RWA Layer 2）
summary: 面向欧盟用户推出 200+ 美股与 ETF 代币，24/5 交易、免佣金；同时宣布基于 Arbitrum 自建 Robinhood Chain 承载代币化资产。
summary_en: Robinhood launched 200+ U.S. stock and ETF tokens for EU users with 24/5 commission-free trading, and announced its own Arbitrum-based Layer 2 to host tokenized assets.

project: Swarm 代币化股票与债券交易
project_en: Swarm tokenized stock & bond trading
asset: 美股（苹果/特斯拉等）+ 美国国债
regulator: 德国 BaFin 监管
summary: 首个获德国 BaFin 监管的 DeFi 交易平台，上线苹果、特斯拉等股票代币与美国国债代币，1:1 由托管资产背书，向合格投资者开放。
summary_en: The first BaFin-regulated DeFi exchange, listing tokenized Apple, Tesla and other stocks plus U.S. Treasury bonds, all 1:1 backed by custodied assets for eligible investors.

project: 首批代币化绿色债券（全球首只政府代币化绿债）
project_en: First tokenised green bond (world's first government tokenised green bond)
asset: 政府绿色债券（1 年期）
regulator: 香港金管局 Project Evergreen
partners: 高盛 GS DAP · 中银香港 · 汇丰 · 瑞银
summary: 全球首批由政府发行的代币化绿色债券，DLT 覆盖一级发行、交收、派息、二级交易到赎回全流程，交收周期从 T+5 缩短至 T+1。
summary_en: The world's first tokenised green bond issued by a government. DLT covered the full lifecycle from issuance and settlement to coupons and redemption, cutting settlement from T+5 to T+1.

project: 第二批数码绿色债券（全球首批多币种数码债券）
project_en: Second digital green bonds (world's first multi-currency digital bonds)
asset: 政府绿色债券（2 年期，四币种）
amount: 约 60 亿港元（港元/人民币/美元/欧元）
regulator: 香港金管局 Project Evergreen
partners: 汇丰 Orion · 中银香港 · 高盛 · 瑞银等
summary: 全球首批多币种数码债券，香港首单数码原生发行，引入 ICMA 债券数据分类标准，国际投资者可经 Euroclear/Clearstream 认购，获全球机构超额认购。
summary_en: The world's first multi-currency digital bond and Hong Kong's first digitally native issuance, adopting ICMA's Bond Data Taxonomy with access via Euroclear and Clearstream.

project: 第三批数码绿色债券（当时全球最大数码债券）
project_en: Third digital green bonds (then the world's largest digital bond)
asset: 政府绿色债券（最长 5 年期，四币种）
amount: 超 100 亿港元（四币种认购超 1300 亿）
regulator: 香港金管局 Project Evergreen
partners: 汇丰 Orion · 代币化央行货币交收（e-HKD / e-CNY）
summary: 全球首批在一级交收中应用人民币及港元代币化央行货币的数码债券，认购金额超 1300 亿港元，为当时全球最大规模数码债券发行。
summary_en: The world's first digital bonds settling with tokenised central bank money (e-HKD and e-CNY) in the primary leg. Subscriptions topped HK$130B across four currencies — the largest digital bond at the time.

project: 首只公链数字债券（以太坊）
project_en: First digital bond on a public blockchain (Ethereum)
asset: 超国家机构债券（2 年期零息）
regulator: 法国央行批发 CBDC 试验交收
partners: 高盛 · 桑坦德 · 法国兴业银行 SG-Forge
summary: 全球首只由银团承销、在公有链（以太坊）发行交收的数字原生债券；此后 EIB 陆续发行欧元私募链债券（GS DAP）与英镑数字债券（汇丰 Orion）。
summary_en: The first multi-dealer digitally native bond issued and settled on a public blockchain, settled with the Banque de France's wholesale CBDC pilot. EIB later issued euro (GS DAP) and sterling (HSBC Orion) digital bonds.

project: 首只企业数字债券（Polygon）
project_en: First corporate digital bond (Polygon)
asset: 企业债券（1 年期）
regulator: 德国电子证券法 eWpG
partners: Hauck Aufhäuser Lampe · DekaBank · Union Investment
summary: 德国《电子证券法》框架下首只直接在公链发行的企业债券，跳过中央清算直接售予机构投资者；2024 年 9 月西门子再发 3 亿欧元二期（SWIAT 平台）。
summary_en: The first corporate bond issued directly on a public chain under Germany's eWpG, sold to institutional investors without central clearing. Siemens followed with a €300M issue via SWIAT in September 2024.

project: PAX Gold（PAXG，代币化黄金）
project_en: PAX Gold (PAXG, tokenized gold)
asset: 伦敦金库实物黄金（每代币 1 金衡盎司）
regulator: 纽约金融服务局 NYDFS 特许发行
summary: 每个 PAXG 对应伦敦 Brinks 金库一金衡盎司实物金条，NYDFS 监管发行，可赎回实物，是最早的合规代币化大宗商品。
summary_en: Each PAXG maps to one troy ounce of a London Good Delivery bar in Brinks vaults. Issued under NYDFS charter and redeemable for physical gold — the earliest regulated tokenized commodity.

project: Tether Gold（XAUT，代币化黄金）
project_en: Tether Gold (XAUT, tokenized gold)
asset: 瑞士金库实物黄金（每代币 1 盎司）
summary: 每枚 XAUT 对应瑞士金库一盎司伦敦金，与 PAXG 并称黄金代币化两大产品，加密市场动荡期规模屡创新高。
summary_en: Each XAUT represents one troy ounce of London Good Delivery gold in a Swiss vault. Alongside PAXG it is one of the two dominant tokenized gold products, hitting new highs in risk-off markets.

project: RealT 美国住宅代币化（底特律等数百套）
project_en: RealT tokenized U.S. rental homes (hundreds in Detroit etc.)
asset: 美国出租住宅物业份额
summary: 最早跑通的房地产代币化平台之一：把美国出租住宅切分为 ERC-20 份额，全球散户几十美元即可持有，租金以稳定币按周派发。
summary_en: Among the first working real-estate tokenization platforms: U.S. rental homes split into ERC-20 shares from ~$50, with rent paid weekly in stablecoins to holders worldwide.

project: Reental 西班牙房产代币化（近百个项目）
project_en: Reental tokenized Spanish properties (~100 projects)
asset: 住宅翻新与出租物业份额
summary: 西班牙头部房产代币化平台，面向散户众筹住宅翻新与出租项目，已上线近百个物业并完成多笔退出，获西班牙 CNMV 沙盒认可。
summary_en: A leading Spanish property tokenization platform crowdfunding residential refurbish-and-rent projects for retail investors, with ~100 properties tokenized and several completed exits.
